main_text.l: longiusculè : pavent experrecti derepentè, circumspiciunt ignota majoribus ocellis, hiant, sudant, & incerta discursatio expedire niº titur illud insuperabile chaos: Ita vagus animus domestico, quem solita familiariaque pandunt, de- stitutus secessu, vacillat inter alie- na, impos sui: & hinc rerum pe- regrinâ facie percellitur, illinc ob- ruitur indigestâ multitudine: Sci- licet ut harmoniâ rerum, & ritè dispositis pacatur animus, ita di- sturbant illum, quæ temerè con- gesta, quæ confusa sunt: angi- mur subinde, & exercet nos mi- nutum quiddam, quod immo- rigerum est, nec ordini concor- dat, quem imaginatio præscripse- rat. Unam aliquam vivendi nor- mam præscribe tibi, non specio- sam; Duram, rationi magis, quàm opinioni consentaneam: in hanc jura:

page.notes: The last word "jura" with its colon stands right-aligned on a separate line. The text is printed in roman type with long s, and the printed "niº" at the line end is a stray mark after "ni" (read as "nitur"). Line "longiusculè" begins the page as a continuation.
